title: Block Quarry / Extraction / Compounding
objective: Turn the already-proven VTC product-to-Block extraction method into a deterministic Hephaestus quarry classifier and extinction-proof pipeline so reusable capability code can compound without deleting host glue or harvesting lookalikes.

evidence: existing visit-tracking, image-prep and affiliate-offer Block extraction evidence
Great Harvest current/historical VTC and Block lineage
great_harvest_preflight.reason: The extraction method and three product patterns already exist; this mission formalizes and proves the reusable classification/pipeline instead of redesigning extraction.

pandaos_reconstruction.rule: Panda-like Skills simplicity may inspire how Block candidates are explained later; Block admission, provenance, maturity and extinction proof remain stronger native OTHRYS law.

laws: Every matching origin region is exactly one of CAPABILITY, HOST_CONFIG, BRIDGE, CALLER, DEBT or FALSE_POSITIVE.
Only independently reusable CAPABILITY algorithm code is extraction target; host glue survives.
Duplicate-algorithm extinction must be proven before origin duplicate deletion is proposed.
Existing admitted Block source is never silently forked into a second canonical implementation.
Quarry classification grants no Block admission, deletion, mutation or execution authority.
Great Harvest evidence is consulted before every extraction candidate is created.
out_of_scope: No mutation of VTC or other origin repos

slices.goal: Implement deterministic extraction classification contract and evidence shape.
Prove classifier against existing visit-tracking, image-prep and affiliate-offer extraction evidence without rewriting those Blocks.
Prove duplicate algorithm count and preserve non-capability hashes/host glue.
Cross-node deterministic proof and negative cases; no admission/deletion authority.
